name: sentiment_ext
description: Sentiment, the repo's original behavior, restated in the behavior schema so it shares one code path with the others. It is the odd one out: the contrast is carried by the prompt itself rather than by a system prompt, so it uses the `train_pairs` form, and its natural metric really is single-token -- '... and I felt ___' is answered by one word. Kept as the regression case: every number in the README came from it, and behavior_eval must still reproduce them. [ext] test arm widened to both polarities of the 25 HELD-OUT test keys (50 prompts). train_pairs untouched, so the CAA direction is identical to behavior_sentiment.json.
